CustomField.description: Assessment Result for Frontline Assessment Pass With Feedback
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Evaluation_Type__c,'Frontline Assessment'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Complete'), AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(ID_d_cust_experiencing_vulnerability__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(ID_d_cust_experiencing_vulnerability__c, 'Not Applicable')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Gave_extra_care_or_met_access_need__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Gave_extra_care_or_met_access_need__c, 'Not Applicable')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Hardship_recorded_referred_managed__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Hardship_recorded_referred_managed__c, 'Not Applicable')), OR(ISPICKVAL(If_resolved_w_o_IDR_letter_RG271_71_met__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(If_resolved_w_o_IDR_letter_RG271_71_met__c, 'Not Applicable')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Was_the_outcome_fair_for_the_customer__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Was_the_outcome_fair_for_the_customer__c, 'Not Applicable')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Was_implementation_timely__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Was_implementation_timely__c, 'Not Applicable')), OR(ISPICKVAL(Addressed_info_req_s_basic_accts_etc__c, 'Met'),ISPICKVAL(Addressed_info_req_s_basic_accts_etc__c, 'Not Applicable')) ), OR( CONTAINS(TEXT(Engaged_with_cust_rep_where_needed__c),'Not Met'), CONTAINS(TEXT(Reasonable_investigation_completed__c),'Not Met'), CONTAINS(TEXT(Were_risk_events_raised_and_recorded__c),'Not Met'), CONTAINS(TEXT(PSI_identified_flagged_where_needed__c),'Not Met'), CONTAINS(TEXT(Were_CMOS_fields_accurate__c),'Not Met'), CONTAINS(TEXT(Cust_interactions_accurately_recorded__c),'Not Met'), CONTAINS(TEXT(Case_notes_clear_and_complete__c),'Not Met'), CONTAINS(TEXT(Other_issues_not_addressed__c),'Not Met') ) ), true, false )
CustomField.label: AssessmentOutcomeFLPassWithFeedback
